sos.staleNote: The location moves only while their app is open. Check how old it is before you go.
sos.endMessage: Only end it if you know {{name}} is safe. Their location will stop being shared and be erased.
sos.tapToManage: Tap to say you are safe or update your location
sos.tapToSee: Tap to see where they are
